prep_used: prep/plan/out.json corrected: M02 and M03 moved to inherited (the two-stage mel-then-generator schedule and the GAN generator losses are the usual separately trained vocoder lineage; their consequences are discussed under M06); M13 kept as a table row (speed and size claims are discussed under M06 because the speedup comes from the decoder and vocoder choice); new M03/M13 topics of prep not built; front-end topic added under M06; M12 kept.

inherited.M01: Recorded talking-face lecture video (Lip2Wav) and read GRID sentences with paired audio
inherited.M02: Paired ground-truth audio: mel targets (SSIM + L1) in stage 1, HiFi-GAN adversarial, mel and feature-matching losses in stage 2
inherited.M03: Two-stage training; upstream frozen in stage 2 on Lip2Wav, sampled 1.2 s windows; single run, no seeds or selection data
inherited.M04: Overt speech video, audio muted at test
inherited.M11: Recorded audio of the same utterance; Lip2Wav splits by reference
inherited.M13: Parameter count and single-GPU batch-1 timing only

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table: studies that synthesize a speech waveform from talking-face or lip video (audio muted at test) and report the acoustic representation and how it becomes a waveform; enhancement with noisy audio at test, talking-head generation, text-only lip reading and video-to-text-to-TTS excluded; versions once. Added for this review: full-text pattern counts (reference lists removed) over the same 165 studies for a non-autoregressive decoder named, an autoregressive or Tacotron decoder named, inference speed reported and parameter count reported, split by first-public date against 2022-07.
topics.design_field: published full-text vocoder counts plus added regexes

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table: studies that decode text, speech or acoustic features from articulator video with a learned image front end, classified by how temporal context enters the front end. Added for this review: a full-text pattern for a transformer visual front end (vision / visual / video transformer, ViT, Swin, transformer pooling) over the 1,342 studies and over the 165 video-to-speech studies, split by first-public date against 2022-07; a mention in related work counts (upper bound).
topics.metric: presence of the design; controlled front-end comparison

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table (165 video-to-speech studies; listener tests, ASR WER on the output, unseen-speaker tests). Added for this review: full-text pattern counts for STOI/ESTOI and PESQ reported, split by first-public date against 2022-07.
topics.metric: objective intelligibility and quality on the same Lip2Wav speakers
